invented.quote: In the seven years since, we have not had a single lab injury that needed more than first aid, with more than 1,200 students handling acids, open flames and glassware.
invented.why: Even assuming the current year is 2026 (seven years after 2019), 7 years at 140 students per year equals 980 students for the writer, and the brief gives no school-wide student numbers or details on specific lab hazards to support 'more than 1,200 students'.
